text: Imagine every human on Earth disappeared.
Not slowly. Not through a war, or a disease.
All eight billion of us, gone in the very same second.
People are talking, laughing, waiting for the lights to change.
No scream. No flash of light.
Every phone call ends in the middle of a word.
Right now, millions of cars are moving on the roads of the world.
In this second, not one of them has a driver.
Most roll on, and slowly come to a stop.
Within minutes, the first alarms begin to wail.
There is no one left to switch them off.
A dog waits beside an empty lead, for someone who will never come back.
One hour in, the city still looks almost normal.
The traffic lights still change. Red, amber, green. For nobody.
But everything that kept this city alive needed people.
And it is already beginning to fail.
